channel.title: Midnight blog - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: Go 1.25 的 WaitGroup.Go 省了 Done，为什么仍要求函数不能 panic？
item.description: Go 1.25 的 WaitGroup.Go 把启动 goroutine 与任务计数关联起来，函数返回时自动完成计数；它没有提供错误收集或 panic 恢复。

item.title: Why must a Go 1.25 WaitGroup.Go function still not panic?
item.description: Go 1.25 WaitGroup.Go couples goroutine startup with task accounting and marks the task done when the function returns. It does not provide error collection or panic recovery.

item.title: sendBeacon 返回 true，为什么仍不能证明服务端保存了数据？
item.description: navigator.sendBeacon 的 true 表示 user agent 已将数据成功排入传输队列，数据总量上限为 65,536 字节；它不返回服务器收据，也不证明已持久化。

item.title: Why doesn't a true sendBeacon result prove that the server stored the data?
item.description: A true navigator.sendBeacon result means the user agent queued data for transfer; queued data is limited to 65,536 bytes. It provides no server acknowledgment and does not prove persistence.

item.title: Prometheus 原生直方图合并后桶变少，为什么不是采集丢数？
item.description: 原生直方图 schema 决定指数桶分辨率。向下缩放会合并桶并减少细节；理解 schema、插值假设和存储预算，才能解释查询结果差异。

item.title: Why can a Prometheus native histogram have fewer buckets after merging without losing samples?
item.description: A native histogram schema sets exponential bucket resolution. Downscaling merges buckets and removes detail; understand schema, interpolation assumptions, and storage budgets before explaining query differences.

item.title: EventBridge Archive 重放历史事件，为什么副作用可能再发生？
item.description: EventBridge archive replay 会把选定时间范围的事件重新送回原 event bus，不会撤销消费者已有副作用，也不保证与原到达顺序一致。重放前要限定目标并保护下游写入。

item.title: Why can replaying an EventBridge archive repeat side effects?
item.description: EventBridge archive replay resends events from a selected time range to the original event bus. It does not undo consumer side effects or preserve original arrival order; scope targets and protect downstream writes first.

item.title: 同一个 iframe 服务，为什么在两个站点读到不同 Cookie？
item.description: CHIPS 的 Partitioned Cookie 按 top-level site 分区，同一嵌入服务在两个顶层站点拥有不同状态。它适合站点内连续性，不是跨站共享登录凭据。

item.title: Why does the same iframe service see different cookies on two sites?
item.description: A CHIPS Partitioned cookie is isolated by top-level site, so one embedded service can have separate state on two sites. It supports per-site continuity, not a shared cross-site login cookie.

item.title: CORS 权限改了，浏览器为什么还会沿用旧预检结果？
item.description: Access-Control-Max-Age 缓存的是预检中的方法和请求头许可，浏览器还可限制其最大时间。策略调整不等于立即清空所有客户端缓存，服务端授权仍需独立执行。

item.title: Why can a browser reuse an old CORS preflight after policy changes?
item.description: Access-Control-Max-Age caches method and header permissions from a preflight, and browsers may impose a lower cap. A policy change does not instantly clear every client cache; server authorization remains separate.

item.title: npm trusted publishing 换成 OIDC，为什么还不能说发布链路安全？
item.description: npm trusted publishing 把受信任的 CI 身份与短时 OIDC 发布凭据关联，减少长期 token；它不证明 workflow、依赖或发布产物没有恶意内容。

item.title: Why doesn't switching npm trusted publishing to OIDC prove the release is safe?
item.description: npm trusted publishing associates a trusted CI identity with short-lived OIDC publishing credentials and reduces long-lived tokens. It does not prove that the workflow, dependencies, or artifact are benign.

item.title: Compose Watch 同步了依赖文件，容器为什么还是跑旧依赖？
item.description: Compose Watch 的 sync、rebuild 和 sync+restart 对应不同变更。同步文件不会自动重建镜像或安装新依赖；选错动作会让开发循环一直验证旧进程。

item.title: Why does a container still use old dependencies after Compose Watch syncs a manifest?
item.description: Compose Watch's sync, rebuild, and sync+restart actions serve different changes. Copying a file does not rebuild an image or install dependencies; the wrong action can keep the development loop on an old process.

item.title: AWS 目标角色允许 12 小时，第二跳凭证为什么仍只有一小时？
item.description: AWS role chaining 的限制取决于凭证来源：用一个角色的临时凭证再 AssumeRole 时，会话最长一小时；这不适用于从用户凭证进行的初次角色假设。

item.title: Why are chained AWS role credentials limited to one hour when the target allows 12?
item.description: AWS role chaining depends on the credential source: assuming another role with temporary credentials from one role caps the session at one hour. That limit does not apply to an initial assumption from user credentials.

item.title: S3 Object Lock 开着，为什么同一个 key 仍然能出现新版本？
item.description: S3 Object Lock 保护的是指定对象版本，而不是冻结 key 名。新版本和 delete marker 仍可能改变当前视图；审计必须围绕 version ID、保留模式和权限。

item.title: Why can an S3 key get a new version while Object Lock is enabled?
item.description: S3 Object Lock protects a specified object version, not a frozen key name. New versions and delete markers can still change the current view; audit version IDs, retention modes, and permissions.

item.title: OTLP 部分成功后，为什么不能把整批遥测再发一次？
item.description: OTLP 的 populated partial_success 表示一次请求可能已有部分数据被接收；协议要求客户端不要重试整个请求。将拒收统计、错误原因和可重试响应分开处理。

item.title: Why shouldn't an OTLP client resend an entire batch after partial success?
item.description: A populated OTLP partial_success means that part of a request may already have been accepted; the protocol says not to retry the whole request. Handle rejection counts and causes separately from retryable responses.

item.title: DNS HTTPS 记录里的 AliasMode 和 ServiceMode，解析路径差在哪？
item.description: RFC 9460 的 AliasMode 表达名称别名和继续解析；ServiceMode 描述具体服务绑定、目标与参数。把两种模式混为一谈会误判客户端下一步要查什么。

item.title: How do AliasMode and ServiceMode differ in DNS HTTPS records?
item.description: In RFC 9460, AliasMode redirects name resolution while ServiceMode describes a service binding, target, and parameters. Treating both as endpoint records obscures the client's next lookup and fallback path.

item.title: Passkey 登录没有弹出候选，conditional mediation 应怎样降级？
item.description: WebAuthn Level 3 的 conditional mediation 是一种可选登录体验能力。先检查客户端是否支持，再保留可见的替代流程；候选界面出现不等于服务器已验证身份。

item.title: How should passkey sign-in degrade when conditional mediation offers no credential?
item.description: WebAuthn Level 3 conditional mediation is an optional sign-in capability. Check client support and keep a visible fallback; displaying a credential candidate does not mean the server has authenticated the user.

item.title: 发了 HTTP Priority，为什么关键响应仍没有先到？
item.description: RFC 9218 让客户端向上游表达响应优先级偏好，也允许服务端给下游中间层提示；它不是跨所有网络节点的强制调度命令。

item.title: Why can a critical response still arrive late after sending HTTP Priority?
item.description: RFC 9218 lets a client express a response-priority preference upstream and a server hint priority to a downstream intermediary. It is not a forced scheduling command across every network hop.

item.title: AsyncLocalStorage.snapshot 捕获上下文后，为什么还要管回调寿命？
item.description: Node.js AsyncLocalStorage.snapshot 可让回调在捕获的异步上下文中运行，但它不会替你缩短闭包和 store 的生命周期。把上下文传播与数据保留分开设计。

item.title: Why does an AsyncLocalStorage.snapshot callback still need a lifetime policy?
item.description: Node.js AsyncLocalStorage.snapshot lets a callback run in a captured async context, but it does not shorten the lifetime of closures or stores. Design context propagation separately from data retention.

item.title: Python 3.14 buffersize 限制了并行提交，却没有改变结果顺序
item.description: Executor.map 的 buffersize 在 Python 3.14 限制已提交但尚未 yield 的任务数量；map 仍按输入顺序交付结果。它提供有界背压，不是完成顺序流。

item.title: Python 3.14 buffersize bounds submissions without changing result order
item.description: In Python 3.14, Executor.map buffersize limits submitted tasks whose results have not been yielded; map still returns results in input order. It provides bounded backpressure, not a completion-order stream.

item.title: Go context 被多个原因取消，Cause 为什么只留下一个？
item.description: WithCancelCause 让 Go 调用方提供取消原因，但它不是原因列表：最先生效的取消决定 Context 的 Cause。把控制流取消与多原因诊断分开，避免日志把竞态解释成因果。

item.title: Why does a Go Context keep only one cause when several cancellations race?
item.description: WithCancelCause lets Go callers attach a reason to cancellation, but it is not a list: the first effective cancellation determines a Context's Cause. Separate control-flow cancellation from multi-cause diagnosis.

item.title: MySQL DDL 卡住时，前一条失败语句为什么还会挡路？
item.description: MySQL 8.4 中，语法有效但执行失败的语句可能仍把 metadata lock 持有到事务结束；autocommit 下则随语句结束释放。查 DDL 等待时要追踪事务和持锁连接，不只看最后一条 SQL。

item.title: Why can a failed MySQL statement still block DDL?
item.description: In MySQL 8.4, a syntactically valid statement that fails during execution can retain a metadata lock until its transaction ends; autocommit releases it with the statement. Trace the transaction and lock holder when DDL waits.

item.title: pg_stat_io 有读写计数，为什么还不能直接说磁盘慢？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 的 pg_stat_io 按 backend、I/O context 和目标对象拆分集群级统计，并有明确的未覆盖路径。先确定观察窗口、计数口径和排除项，才可能把指标用于排障。

item.title: Why don't pg_stat_io read and write counts prove that storage is slow?
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 pg_stat_io splits cluster-wide statistics by backend, I/O context, and target object, with documented blind spots. Define the window, counter semantics, and exclusions before using it for diagnosis.

item.title: PostgreSQL 18 事务超时，为什么会把连接一起结束？
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 的 transaction_timeout 限制的是一次事务占用会话的总时长，触发后会终止会话。理解它与语句超时、空闲事务超时的比较关系，再决定按角色或连接设置。

item.title: Why can a PostgreSQL 18 transaction timeout end the connection too?
item.description: PostgreSQL 18 transaction_timeout limits the total lifetime of a transaction by terminating its session. Understand how it interacts with statement and idle-transaction timeouts before choosing a role or connection scope.

item.title: Deploying a Hexo + Midnight Blog: Build from Source or Publish Static Files?
item.description: A maintainable Hexo + Midnight blog depends on separating source, the public build, hosting, and DNS. Compare Vercel source builds with a separate static-artifact repository, then verify the release boundary.

item.title: CODEOWNERS rules do not accumulate: the last matching line changes the reviewers
item.description: GitHub CODEOWNERS assigns reviewers by path pattern, with the last matching rule taking precedence. Put multiple optional owners for one pattern on the same line, and remember that a pull request uses the target branch's version.

item.title: Why is an S3 multipart ETag not the MD5 of the whole file?
item.description: An S3 multipart ETag identifies a completed object but is not guaranteed to be the whole-file MD5. Choose a checksum algorithm and full/composite type when initiating the upload, then validate the stored checksum on completion and retrieval.

item.title: A GitHub Environment can delay deployment secrets, but only when the job references it
item.description: A GitHub Actions job that references an environment must pass its protection rules before it can run or access that environment's secrets. Repository visibility and plan affect which rules are available.

item.title: Why has AbortSignal.timeout not expired after a page was suspended?
item.description: AbortSignal.timeout measures active time, not simply wall-clock time. Its clock pauses while a document is in the back-forward cache or a Worker is suspended, so it is not an absolute server-side deadline.

item.title: SQS heartbeats can reduce premature redelivery, but the 12-hour limit does not reset
item.description: An SQS visibility timeout is a lease-like way to hide a message temporarily, not a processing lock. Renewals remain subject to a 12-hour ceiling from the first ReceiveMessage, so consumers must plan for duplicate delivery and delayed retries.

item.title: SQS FIFO's five-minute deduplication protects send retries, not business side effects
item.description: Amazon SQS FIFO uses a message deduplication ID to prevent duplicate enqueueing within a five-minute window. It does not make a consumer's charge or database write happen once, and content hashing excludes message attributes.

item.title: Python audit hooks can log and abort events, but they cannot sandbox the interpreter
item.description: Python 3.12's sys.addaudithook is intended for runtime auditing. An existing hook can prevent a new hook from being installed without an explicit error, so the security boundary still belongs outside the interpreter.

item.title: Node.js permissions can limit a process, but they are not a sandbox for hostile code
item.description: Node.js 22's --permission can reduce accidental access to files, child processes, and Workers in trusted programs. The official documentation explicitly says it is not a security boundary against malicious code.

item.title: 页面挂起后 AbortSignal.timeout 为什么还没超时？
item.description: AbortSignal.timeout 使用活动时间而不是简单墙上时钟；文档进入 BFCache 或 Worker 挂起时计时会暂停，不能把它当作服务器端绝对期限。

item.title: CMake 生成表达式写对了语法，为什么仍没有展开？
item.description: Generator expression 在生成阶段、且只在支持它的属性或命令上下文中求值；命令参数解析早于求值，含分号或空格时还要先正确引用。

item.title: Docker 构建缓存有了 mount，为什么 CI 每次还是重新下载？
item.description: BuildKit cache mount 是构建器本地的可回收性能缓存，不写入镜像层，也不随 --cache-to 导出；CI 新建 builder 时可能为空，构建不能依赖其内容正确性。

item.title: EventBridge 目标不可用，默认重试为何五分钟后停止？
item.description: EventBridge 对目标投递在达到最大尝试次数或事件年龄上限时先停止；DLQ 要显式配置，重试成功也不等于业务副作用只发生一次。

item.title: CODEOWNERS 规则不是累加的，最后一个匹配行会改变审查人
item.description: GitHub CODEOWNERS 按路径匹配并由最后匹配规则决定 owner；同一模式的多个审核人必须写在同一行，且 PR 使用目标分支版本。

item.title: GitHub Environment 能推迟部署密钥访问，但前提是作业真正引用它
item.description: GitHub Actions 作业引用 environment 后，先通过该环境保护规则才能运行并访问其 secrets；仓库可见性和套餐会影响可用规则。

item.title: CRD YAML 提交成功，字段却消失：先检查结构化 schema 的裁剪
item.description: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 的 CRD 需要结构化 schema；未声明字段默认可能在 API server 持久化前被裁剪，保留未知子树必须显式设计并测试。

item.title: kubectl debug 能往运行中的 Pod 加容器，为什么还要单独授权？
item.description: Kubernetes ephemeral container 通过 pods/ephemeralcontainers 子资源加入既有 Pod；能 patch Pod 并不必然等于能执行这个诊断操作。

item.title: Server-Side Apply 冲突说明字段有人负责，不等于配置无法更新
item.description: Kubernetes SSA 按字段记录 manager；改动他人管理且值不同的字段会冲突，强制覆盖会转移所有权。先厘清控制器与发布工具的职责，再决定是否 force。

item.title: Node.js 权限模型能收紧进程权限，但不是运行陌生代码的沙箱
item.description: Node.js 22 的 --permission 适合减少可信程序误用文件、子进程和 Worker 的机会；官方明确不把它当作抵御恶意代码的安全边界。

item.title: Node 测试里的时钟被推进了，为什么 Promise 还没完成？
item.description: Node test runner 的 MockTimers 推进虚拟 timer/Date 时钟，但 setTime、tick 和 Promise 微任务不是一个概念；先明确要驱动哪种等待。

item.title: 指标图上看到尖峰，却找不到请求：OpenTelemetry exemplar 连接了什么？
item.description: Exemplar 是附在指标数据点上的一次代表性观测，可带 trace_id 和 span_id 帮助从聚合指标跳到 trace；它不增加每个请求都要存储的 span。

item.title: Python audit hook 能记录和中止事件，但不能把解释器变成沙箱
item.description: Python 3.12 的 sys.addaudithook 面向运行时审计；钩子安装本身可能被已有钩子拒绝且不显式报出，安全边界仍须放在解释器之外。

item.title: Redis WAIT 返回 2，为什么仍不能说写入已经耐久？
item.description: WAIT 等待当前连接此前写命令被指定数量的副本确认；调用方必须核对返回数。它提高故障安全概率，但不提供强一致或独立持久化保证。

item.title: S3 分段上传返回的 ETag 为什么不能当成整文件 MD5？
item.description: S3 multipart ETag 标识组合对象，却不保证等于整文件 MD5；应在创建上传时选择 checksum 算法与 full/composite 类型，再按存储的校验值验证完整性。

item.title: 版本化 S3 对象 DELETE 返回成功，为什么旧文件还在？
item.description: 启用版本控制的 S3 桶中，不带 versionId 的 DELETE 通常创建 delete marker，让对象表现为已删除；恢复要精确移除当前 marker，永久删除旧版本则是另一项操作。

item.title: SQS FIFO 的五分钟去重保护的是发送重试，不是业务副作用
item.description: Amazon SQS FIFO 按消息去重 ID 在五分钟窗口内避免重复入队；它不替消费者保证一次性扣款或数据库写入，内容哈希也不包含消息属性。

item.title: SQS 心跳续租能减少抢重消息，但十二小时上限不会重置
item.description: SQS visibility timeout 是暂时隐藏消息的租约式机制，不是处理锁；续租仍受首次 ReceiveMessage 后十二小时上限约束，消费者要为重复投递和慢重试设计。

item.title: Terraform for_each 改了 map key，为什么计划要重建云资源？
item.description: for_each 的 key 成为 Terraform resource address 的实例身份；改 key 默认表示旧实例离开、新实例出现，需用 moved block 或 state mv 表达重命名。

item.title: TypeScript `satisfies` 能检查配置，却不把它抹成宽泛接口
item.description: `satisfies` 在保持表达式推断结果的同时检查它是否符合目标类型；它可发现缺键或错值类型，却不是运行时验证，也不绕过字面量推断规则。

item.title: The CMake generator expression is valid, so why did it not expand?
item.description: Generator expressions are evaluated during generation and only in supported properties or command contexts. Command-argument parsing happens first, so quoting may matter.

item.title: Why does CI still download dependencies after adding a Docker cache mount?
item.description: A BuildKit cache mount is reclaimable builder-local performance state, not an image layer or an exported --cache-to cache. A fresh CI builder may start empty.

item.title: Why does an EventBridge target stop retrying after five minutes by default?
item.description: EventBridge stops delivery when either the retry-attempt or event-age limit is reached. A DLQ must be configured explicitly, and a successful retry does not guarantee exactly-once side effects.

item.title: A CRD apply succeeds but a field disappears: check schema pruning first
item.description: A structural OpenAPI schema defines what a CRD persists. Unknown fields may be pruned before storage unless a specific subtree explicitly preserves them.

item.title: Why does kubectl debug need separate permission to add a container to a running Pod?
item.description: Kubernetes adds an ephemeral container through the pods/ephemeralcontainers subresource. Permission to patch a Pod does not automatically grant this diagnostic capability.

item.title: A Server-Side Apply conflict says a field has an owner, not that it can never change
item.description: SSA records field managers. A conflicting value is rejected, while force transfers ownership; first clarify controller responsibilities before using force-conflicts.

item.title: The test clock moved forward, so why is the Promise still pending?
item.description: Node's test-runner MockTimers controls selected timer and Date APIs, but setTime, tick, and Promise microtasks are distinct. Decide which wait your test must drive.

item.title: A metric chart shows a spike but no request: what does an OpenTelemetry exemplar connect?
item.description: An exemplar attaches a selected measurement to a metric point and can carry trace and span IDs. It helps jump from an aggregate to a trace without storing a span for every request.

item.title: Redis WAIT returned 2; why is the write still not necessarily durable?
item.description: WAIT checks replica acknowledgments for earlier writes on the current connection. The caller must check the returned count; this improves safety but does not guarantee strong consistency or persistence.

item.title: Why is the old file still there after DELETE succeeded in a versioned S3 bucket?
item.description: In a versioned S3 bucket, DELETE without versionId usually creates a delete marker. Recovery removes that exact marker; permanently deleting old versions is a separate operation.

item.title: Why does changing a Terraform for_each key plan to replace a cloud resource?
item.description: A for_each key becomes part of a Terraform resource address. Renaming it can look like one instance was removed and another added; use a moved block or state mv for a deliberate rename.

item.title: TypeScript `satisfies` checks a config without widening it to a broad interface
item.description: `satisfies` checks compatibility while preserving the expression's inferred result. It catches missing keys and bad value types, but is neither runtime validation nor an escape from inference rules.

item.title: 放进 requestIdleCallback，为什么长循环仍会挡住页面？
item.description: 用四项有界队列解释空闲预算为何不会自动打断同步工作，区分未运行页面与已执行的超时策略纯函数。

item.title: CTest 只选一项测试，怎样让它的准备和清理也被执行？
item.description: 选中消费者时自动带入fixture准备与清理，用失败准备和独立日志验证执行集合。

item.title: RUN 的 bind mount 加了 rw，生成文件为什么下一步不见了？
item.description: 用构建内外两条输出路径验证RUN bind写入寿命，保留只读失败和stage来源对照。

item.title: check-ignore 对已跟踪文件没输出，怎样核对它会匹配哪条规则？
item.description: 分开读取忽略规则与索引，用no-index诊断已跟踪路径，并识别否定模式的verbose输出。

item.title: Base64 Strict 为什么仍接受输入里的换行？
item.description: 用正确尾位、错误尾位、CRLF 和无填充输入，核对 Strict 的具体边界；Go 程序未执行。

item.title: OpenFile 加 O_CREATE 后，旧文件后半段为什么还在？
